jobs.title: Senior Product Designer

company.name: CloudScale AI
company.about: CloudScale AI builds the infrastructure that helps product teams turn complex data into fast, reliable experiences.

jobs.summary: Own the end-to-end design of CloudScale AI's core data platform and help technical teams do their best work.
jobs.description: At CloudScale AI, we are building the next generation of infrastructure monitoring tools. We are looking for a Senior Product Designer who is passionate about translating complex technical workflows into elegant, intuitive interfaces. You will be a key member of our design team, working closely with engineering and product leadership to define the vision for our core platform experience.
responsibilities: Lead the end-to-end design process for major platform features, from discovery to high-fidelity implementation.
Collaborate with cross-functional partners to understand user needs and translate them into functional design requirements.
Maintain and evolve our design system, ensuring consistency and accessibility across the entire product suite.
Conduct user research and usability testing to validate design decisions and iterate based on feedback.

items: 5+ years of experience designing complex B2B SaaS products or data-heavy applications.
A strong portfolio showcasing your design process and problem-solving skills.
